name: Reply to a referral
subjectVariants: Thanks, I’ll reach out to them
bodyMd:
{{#if contact.firstName}}Hello {{contact.firstName}},{{else}}Hello,{{/if}}

Thank you for taking the time to point me to the right person; that helps a great deal. I will get in touch with them directly, mention that you passed my note along, and keep it short.

Have a good day, and my best to the team at {{business.name}}.

Best regards,
